name: Pennsylvania
title: Pennsylvania Rebate Calculator 2026: PECO and PPL Electric Heat Pump and Thermostat Rebates
h1: Pennsylvania Rebate Calculator 2026: What Your Utility Pays
desc: Free Pennsylvania rebate calculator for PECO and PPL Electric customers. Heat pump, water heater, thermostat and insulation rebates, with the official source for every amount.
intro: Pennsylvania rebates are small and come from your electric utility. This calculator shows what PECO and PPL Electric pay today.
short: Pennsylvania has no statewide heat pump rebate. PECO pays $200 to $300 for a heat pump, $350 for a heat pump water heater and $25 to $50 for a smart thermostat. PPL Electric pays $400 for a heat pump water heater, $50 to $100 for a thermostat and up to $500 for insulation. The state solar program and the federal tax credits have ended.
faq: Is there a heat pump rebate in Pennsylvania?

Only from some utilities. PECO pays $200 or $300 for an air-source heat pump and $150 or $300 for a ductless one, depending on efficiency. PPL Electric lists $225 to $500 but its offer changes, so confirm it with PPL. We have not verified Duquesne Light or Penelec amounts.
Is there a solar rebate in Pennsylvania?
No current statewide one. The PA Sunshine program stopped taking applications in 2013, and PECO's Act 129 solar rebate has ended.
Is the federal heat pump tax credit still available?
No. The 25C and 25D credits ended for spending after December 31, 2025.
How long do I have to apply to PECO?
Within 90 days of purchase for the heat pump and water heater rebates.

programs.name: PECO air-source heat pump
programs.rules: $200 at 15.2 to 17.0 SEER2, $300 at 17.1 SEER2 or higher. Minimums: 11.0 EER2 and 7.8 HSPF2. Apply within 90 days of purchase.

programs.name: PECO ductless mini-split heat pump
programs.rules: $150 or $300 depending on efficiency. Apply within 90 days of purchase.

programs.name: PECO heat pump water heater
programs.rules: ENERGY STAR certified electric model. Apply within 90 days of purchase.

programs.name: PPL Electric heat pump
programs.rules: Air source $225 or $325, mini-split $225, ground source $500, depending on your offer. Confirm the current offer with PPL, so it is not added to your total. Equipment installed on or before May 31, 2026 is no longer eligible.
